column4:
This directory contains all
audio file in .wav format which
are used to generate tones on
receipt of Warned, Lock- On,
CW, FCR type of emitters.

This directory stores Shakti
system configuration file.

This directory stores Shakti
system database backup files.

This directory contains ELINT
returns files. ELINT returns file
contains intercepted emitters
that are added by operator
during mission in online mode.

This directory contains the ES
library files.

This directory contains emitter
libraries in the form of sanchay
format files.

This directory contains three
subdirectories i.e. login, offline
& Shakti_online.
(a) The login subdirectory
stores the login help files.
(b) The offline stores the
offline related help files.
(c) Shakti_online
subdirectory stores the online
related help files.

This directory contains all tiff
map related files.
